item.title: Hot Jazz Saturday Night: January 24, 2026
item.description: This week on Hot Jazz Saturday Night, there’s snow in the forecast and snow in the playlist! Also newly released broadcast recordings by the Glenn Miller Orchestra and transcribed recordings from 1934 featuring Benny Goodman, Bunny Berigan and Jack Teagarden.

item.title: D.C. Del. Eleanor Holmes Norton files to ‘terminate’ reelection campaign
item.description: Norton’s campaign raised just $2,520 during the last three months of 2025. Her campaign hasn’t yet announced a formal decision on her future.

item.title: Voices of Wards 7 and 8: At this small Catholic school, Southeast girls find sisterhood and community
item.description: In Wards 7 and 8, most students go to public school - but a small number have the opportunity to attend the Washington School for Girls, an independent catholic school that offers full scholarships to its students. This year, with a new campus at the heart of the Southeast community, the girls are looking forward to the start of a new chapter.

item.title: After D.C. clears homeless encampments, health workers warn of growing risks
item.description: While Trump administration officials say that sweeps of homeless encampments make public spaces safer, health workers say they are disrupting care for people with serious medical needs and increasing the risk of illness and death.
